example_prompt: Receive Smile ID's verification verdict on my callback URL, verify the Response-Signature, and update the user's KYC status from status, reason and id_fields.

input_schema.description: JSON body Smile ID POSTs to your callback_url when an Enhanced KYC, Biometric KYC or Document Verification job completes (fields from their webhook pages; image_links and device_signals come with Document Verification and Biometric KYC). Other products (e.g. One-Time AML) send a different payload — see their webhook pages.

status.description: The overall disposition of the verification. One of `clear`, `attention`, `block`, or `error`.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the verification outcome.

reason.description: A machine-readable code indicating the specific cause of the status. `null` when `status` is `clear`.

product.description: The Smile ID product that produced this result (e.g. `enhanced_kyc`, `biometric_kyc`, `document_verification`).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the verification job was created.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the verification job completed.

partner_params.description: Partner-provided metadata submitted with the original request. Custom keys sent with the request come back too: a sandbox Enhanced KYC webhook (live test, 2026-10-24) echoed internal_reference next to job_id and user_id, without job_type.

job_type.description: The job type for the verification (`5` for Enhanced KYC, `6` for Document Verification, `1` for Biometric KYC — "Always `1` for Biometric KYC"). Listed in the field tables but absent from the Enhanced KYC and Document Verification example payloads.

job_id.description: Smile ID job id (present in the example payloads).

user_id.description: User id (present in the example payloads).

id_fields.description: Personal information returned by the ID authority. `null` when `status` is `block` or `error`.

full_name.description: Full name as recorded by the ID authority.

gender.description: Gender as recorded by the ID authority.

is_deceased.description: Whether the individual is recorded as deceased.

issuance_date.description: Date the ID document was issued, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

expiration_date.description: Date the ID document expires, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

photo_url.description: Signed URL to the ID photo image. The URL expires after 15 minutes.

document_link.description: Signed URL to the ID document image, if available. The URL expires after 15 minutes.

phone_number.description: Primary phone number on file with the ID authority.

email.description: Email address on file with the ID authority.

occupation.description: Occupation as recorded by the ID authority.

marital_status.description: Marital status as recorded by the ID authority.

place_of_issuance.description: Location where the ID document was issued.

id_status.description: Status of the ID document as reported by the authority.

date_of_death.description: Date of death in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, if the individual is recorded as deceased.

secondary_id_number.description: A secondary ID number associated with the individual, if available.

address_unparsed.description: Full address as a single unstructured string.

country.description: Country of issuance (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code). (Document Verification)

id_type.description: The document type (classified automatically when not supplied in the request). (Document Verification)

user_provided_info.description: The personal information submitted in the original verification request.

given_names.description: Given names as provided in the request.

last_name.description: Last name as provided in the request.

id_number.description: ID number as provided in the request.

email.description: Email address as provided in the request.

phone_number.description: Phone number as provided in the request.

fraud_risk.description: Fraud risk assessment from Smile ID's risk engine.

risk_indicators.description: List of risk indicator codes that contributed to the risk assessment. Empty when no risk is detected.

risk_level.description: Overall risk level. One of `low`, `medium`, or `high`.

risk_score.description: Numeric risk score from 0 (no risk) to 100 (highest risk).

indicator_details.description: Detailed metadata for each risk indicator listed in `fraud_risk.risk_indicators`. Empty when no risk is detected. Observed as null (not {}) in a sandbox Enhanced KYC webhook with no risk detected (live test, 2026-10-24).

additionalProperties.description: Detail object keyed by indicator code (for example `risk_indicator_1`).

description.description: Human-readable explanation of why that indicator contributed to the risk assessment.

smile_secure.description: Results from Smile ID's Smile Secure duplicate detection system.

status.description: Smile Secure result. One of `clear`, `attention`, or `error`.

message.description: Human-readable description of the Smile Secure result.

suspect_users.description: Users previously associated with the same identity, if any duplicates are detected.

user_id.description: The user ID of the matched prior verification.

reasons.description: Why the user was matched. Values: `same-id-number` and `same-face`.

fraud_detected.description: `true` if any fraud signal was detected across all fraud checks.

fraud_sources.description: List of fraud check sources that detected fraud (e.g., `fraud_risk`). Empty when no fraud is detected.

consent.description: Consent record following the ISO 27560 schema. Present in every webhook.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for the consent record.

pii_principal_id.description: Identifier of the individual who granted consent.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the privacy notice shown to the individual.

privacy_notice.description: URL of the privacy notice presented to the individual.

event.description: List of consent events associated with this record.

entity_id.description: Identifier of the consent grant entity.

event_state.description: State of the consent event (e.g., `consent given`).

event_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the consent event occurred.

validity_duration.description: Duration in seconds for which the consent remains valid.

purposes.description: List of processing purposes covered by the consent.

purpose.description: The stated purpose for data processing.

pii_information.description: List of PII field types covered by the consent.

pii_controllers.description: Organizations controlling the PII (includes Smile ID and the partner).

storage_locations.description: Countries where data is stored (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes).

processing_locations.description: Countries where data is processed (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes).

codes_of_conduct.description: URL to applicable codes of conduct.

impact_assessment.description: URL to the data protection impact assessment.

privacy_rights.description: Map of privacy right names to their respective URLs.

kyc_receipt.description: Signed URL to a PDF verification receipt. `null` when `status` is `error`. The URL expires after 15 minutes.

image_links.description: URLs to the images submitted with the request. `null` when `status` is `error`.

selfie_image.description: Signed URL to the submitted selfie image. The URL expires after 15 minutes.

id_card_image.description: Signed URL to the submitted document front image. The URL expires after 15 minutes.

id_card_back_image.description: Signed URL to the submitted document back image, if a back image was submitted. The URL expires after 15 minutes.

device_signals.description: Device, network, and SDK signals derived from the metadata submitted with the job. `null` when `status` is `error`, or when no metadata was submitted.

device_information.description: Information about the device that performed the capture.

user_agent.description: User agent of the client that submitted the job.

accuracy.description: Accuracy of the location reading, in meters.

network_connectivity.description: Network signals for the connection used to submit the job.

ip.description: IP address the job was submitted from.

ip_information.description: Enriched information about the IP address.

city.description: City associated with the IP address.

country.description: Country associated with the IP address.

ip_timezone.description: Timezone associated with the IP address.

isp.description: Internet service provider of the IP address.

latitude.description: Latitude associated with the IP address.

longitude.description: Longitude associated with the IP address.

region.description: Region associated with the IP address.

is_proxy.description: Whether the IP address is a known proxy.

is_vpn.description: Whether the IP address is a known VPN endpoint.

sdk_application.description: Details of the SDK and host application that submitted the job.

host_application.description: Identifier of the application hosting the SDK.

sdk.description: The Smile ID SDK used for the capture.

uses_wrapper.description: Whether the SDK runs inside a wrapper framework (e.g., React Native, Flutter).

wrapper_name.description: Name of the wrapper framework, if any.

wrapper_version.description: Version of the wrapper framework, if any.

response_schema.description: Respond with any 2xx status within 35 seconds to acknowledge the webhook.

gotchas: Verify every webhook before trusting it: compute HMAC-SHA256 over Response-Timestamp + your partner ID + the literal string 'sid_request', keyed with the API key used to mint the original request's token, base64-encode it and compare with the Response-Signature header. Use the raw Response-Timestamp header value — do not reformat it.
Return a 2xx within 35 seconds. Otherwise Smile ID retries immediately, up to 3 times (4 attempts in total), then stops — recover a lost result with replay_verification_webhook.
Delivery is at-least-once and unordered: deduplicate and correlate on the smileid-job-id header and the user-id field, not on arrival order.
This webhook is the only authoritative verdict. The Web SDK's onResult 'success' only means the job was submitted; a Smile Link redirect fires on submit or cancel and can be forged by the end user.

Branch on status (clear, attention, block, error) and reason. id_fields is null when status is block or error; antifraud is null when status is error. The shape of id_fields depends on product, country and ID type — every field is nullable.
photo_url, document_link, image_links.* and kyc_receipt are signed URLs that expire after 15 minutes — download what you need to keep immediately.

Callback URLs are set per environment in the Dashboard (Developer > Security Settings > Callback URLs) or per request with callback_url. If you filter inbound traffic by IP, allow Smile ID's callback IPs (production: 13.51.0.119, 34.240.137.52, 51.20.27.3, 52.213.46.74; sandbox: 13.48.228.158, 16.170.104.93, 54.246.37.255, 99.81.237.141).

evidence.source_reference: Receive Webhooks — Webhook Signature, Automatic Retries, Webhook Sequencing
spans: Webhooks are retried up to **3 times** after the initial attempt
Your server must respond within **35 seconds**.
